why: Multiple 2025-2026 arXiv preprints report the conjecture proved for successively more runners (k=8, then 9 and 10, then up to 12/13), each a case of the general conjecture stated on Wikipedia, extending the previously known case k<=7.

found.title: The lonely runner conjecture holds for eight runners
found.note: Preprint by Rosenfeld claiming a computer-assisted proof for k=8; not read.

found.title: Nine and ten lonely runners
found.note: Preprint extending the sieve approach to prove k=9 and k=10; not read.

found.title: Eleven, twelve, and thirteen lonely runners
found.note: Preprint title suggests further extension to k=11,12,13; date on the arXiv identifier looks unusual (2604), not verified; not read.

found.title: New Strides Made on Deceptively Simple 'Lonely Runner' Problem
